messages:
ria: proposing final scope for 'Optimize advisor' pilot: advisor recommendations (batch/cache/quant) + eval-triggered alerts + revert UX. Pilot with one latency-sensitive tenant and one cost-sensitive tenant.
omar: agree. keep advisor advisory-first with optional auto-apply for trusted tenants. dry-run mode mandatory.
jess: telemetry requirements: per-tenant cost_est, p50/p95 latency, stewarded_quality_score, alerts_history. exportable CSV. retention 30d.
dinesh: eval rules: stewarded prompt checks + population drift. example: "if stewarded semantic sim < 0.94 over 500 samples -> alert". alerts should include remediation suggestions (rollback quant, reduce batch, enable cache-only).
lina: UX: show tokens_saved_est, latency_delta_est, confidence, sample before/after responses for 3 stewarded prompts, and a revert CTA. include auto-generated rollback text for CS.
omar: batching presets for pilot: latency_profile {max_batch:12,max_wait_ms:40} cost_profile {max_batch:56,max_wait_ms:130}. caching: prefix KV for hotspots, ttl 45s, per-route opt-in.
dinesh: quant recommendation policy: require shadow-run on 500 samples and thresholds: top-k overlap >= 0.92 AND embedding cosine >= 0.95 to recommend int8. otherwise suggest no-change.
ria: draft pilot acceptance criteria: cost reduction >= 9% on cost tenant OR p95 latency change <= +20ms on latency tenant; stewarded false alert rate <= 4%; revert path validated.
omar: infra blocker: need temporary replay quota and small staging pool for shadow runs. filing ENG-INFR ticket.
infra-bot: reminder - maintenance window 2223334500-2223334800, avoid heavy replay jobs then.
ria: action items: 1) ria - write RFC + acceptance checklist by Tue EOD, 2) omar - replay estimator spike by Fri, 3) dinesh - shadow-run POC by Fri, 4) jess - telemetry + UX samples by Mon, 5) lina - pilot signoff template by Mon.
ria: locking scope if no objections. ack with :white_check_mark:.
omar: ack
jess: ack
dinesh: ack
lina: ack
infra-bot: ria uploaded rfc-draft.pdf (https://redwood.dev/specs/optimize-advisor-rfc)
